title: Rishtey - A Grand Celebration
desc: After falling in love with each other, a man and a woman must overcome obstacles and the generation-long rift between their families.

title: Beta Ho To Aisa
desc: When Laxmi's servant is killed, she brings up his son Raju with her own children. When they get involved in some shady dealings, it's up to Raju to sort out the mess his family is in.

title: Phool Bane Angaray
desc: After her husband, Ranjit, a police officer, is killed by the corrupt and powerful Bishamber, Namrata pledges to avenge his death and bring him justice.

title: Jigar
desc: Duryodhan, a wrestler, is Raju's friend, but due to a misunderstanding he rapes and kills Raju's sister. Raju later seeks Baba Thakur's help to train in fighting to avenge his sister's death.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.
